thread:
Maya: FYI: Two customers uploaded legacy .bin checkpoints; our hotstart index-first path throws hard errors. Need a migration approach that doesn't force resave to safetensors.
Chris: What failures are we seeing? header parse or offset mismatches?
Maya: Index lookup fails and CRC mismatch during full-validate. The loader rejects files during warmup.
Samuel: Suggest a compatibility shim that lazily builds an index while streaming ranges and schedules a background full-validate.
Lee: I prototyped a bin->ephemeral-manifest shim: streams byte ranges in bounded buffers, emits per-chunk rolling checksums, writes a stub manifest to cache. Background validator upgrades or marks corrupted shards.
Chris: Two constraints: avoid OOMs when streaming and avoid persisting unverified manifests as authoritative.
Zara: Proposed "gentle-migrate" feature flag. Shim creates ephemeral signed manifest stubs flagged as "unverified-origin" in Console. Promotion to signed manifest requires explicit full-validate and signing via KMS.
Maya: Rollout: host API read-only shim behind feature flag (no auto-promote). Dedicated/Private: opt-in migration tooling.
Samuel: Impl notes: streaming reader must bound memory (<= 2x chunk_size), compute rolling CRC per chunk, persist stub manifest with timestamps and partial checksums, schedule background validation per-shard.
Lee: Expose loader ABI: load.checkpoint_compat({path, mode: "gentle"}) -> {manifest_ref, verified}. manifest_ref must be internal ID or expiring signed URL.
Chris: Detect structural corruption (overlapping ranges) during streaming and fail-fast for that shard. Allow checksum mismatches to be handled by background validator and route degraded shards to fallback variants.
Zara: Rollout checklist: infra flag, streaming stub + background validator, devex CLI rw-binshim (convert/promote), KB article, SRE alerts for validation-fail spikes.
Chris: CLI examples: ./rw-binshim convert --input model.bin --index-only --out s3://tmp-stub; ./rw-binshim promote --stub s3://tmp-stub --sign-with kms://key
Maya: Metrics: compat.stub_created, compat.promoted, compat.validation_fail, compat.degraded_shard_count; histograms for validation latency.
Samuel: Security: manifest_ref must enforce ACLs; do not expose raw S3 paths without checks.
Zara: Feature toggle per-namespace so we can test enterprise customers first.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z -> 1% host traffic
Maya: I'll own loader impl; Samuel owns validator; Chris+Lee pair on manifest format/ABI; Zara will own rollout/docs. Will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
